description: Optional, independently useful MCP migration diagnostics skills; the public CLI and basic skill are complete without them.

advanced_skills.name: mcp-migration-assistant
advanced_skills.description: Guided VS Code/Copilot migration planning, reviewable JSON-Patch plan files with target hash checks, explicit conflict resolution, and offline post-migration verification.
advanced_skills.evidence_example: examples/vscode.json to examples/copilot-portable.json: preserved command/args/env after documented reference translation; baseline diff is empty.

advanced_skills.name: mcp-config-auditor
advanced_skills.description: Offline heuristic risk/completeness checks for embedded secrets, tool exposure, unpinned command launchers, unsupported fields, and cross-config drift; emits pointer-only findings.
advanced_skills.evidence_example: examples/with-cwd.json demonstrates a documented portability loss; audit findings identify the affected JSON Pointer without printing sensitive values.

access.reward: Both advanced skill directories, provided only for a correct optional puzzle submission
